_doc: Drive 9 whole-character round 5 finish: an overlay deep-merged over r4_finish.json (d9_post.load_finish, lists replaced whole). Each change answers a round-4 blind critic (review/rosace/art/drive9/round-4/verdicts/); the reasons are in 'why'. The 'r5' block switches on round 5's steps in drive9/r5_post.py (rim_arcs replaces round 4's rim_limit). The paint-over runs after this (r4_paint.py with the round-5 override files).

why.hair: Face critic (round 4, head and hair 4): 'a nearly single-hue purple mass with 2-3 flat steps ... the refs' hair has 5+ hue-shifted tones: near-black indigo shadow, then violet, then a lavender sheen'. The ramp now runs blue-navy (#121a44) -> indigo -> violet -> red-violet (#8650b2) -> orchid -> pink-lavender (#d6b0dc) at the top (hue about 235 -> 290 deg), chroma 0.85 -> 1.0. Gamma 1.35 (the low key) is kept.
why.hairtip: Materials critic (palette 15): 'blue accent used on gem, ribbons, bow-ties and weapon glints dilutes it; reserve saturated blue for the gem and eyes'. The 'ribbons' are the hair's azure tips (hairtip is 72 px on the idle, on the side masses and tails; the body critic's 'detached blue claw at the hip' is the tail's tips). DESIGN keeps azure tips, so they stay blue but go periwinkle and softer (#5876c4 mid, was #4193e6), under the glaive gem's saturation.
why.rim: Materials critic (rim light 17, 4.5): 'rim appears as dotted white beads on the dark sleeve edge, reads as noise rather than light ... threshold to solid 1-px arcs'. rim_arcs: runs under 5 px go back to the outline, a longer run keeps one contiguous arc of up to 7 px from its most rim-facing pixel (a second arc on runs over 22 px).
why.contour: Materials critic (pixel craft 16, 5.5): 'orphan light pixels stippled along the tabard and sleeve outlines ... remove isolated contour pixels (1-px islands differing from both neighbours)'.
why.trim: Weapon-grip-outfit critic (outfit 13): 'bodice still grey blobs ... bodice tension lines + gold underbust trim'; body critic (body 5): 'a 2-tone underbust shadow'. A 1 px gold trim on the bodice's bottom edge over skin, the skin under it two steps darker.
